name: Otter Compass
tagline: One compass for your pet's whole life — health, whereabouts, and everything left unsaid.
positioning: Otter Compass fuses collar sensors, vet records, and daily habits into one predictive map that tells you what your animal can't.

hero.h1: Every heartbeat, step, and secret your pet keeps — finally mapped.
hero.sub: Otter Compass turns collar sensors, vet history, and quiet daily habits into one living map of your animal's wellbeing — so you spot the storm days before the first symptom.

features.title: Whereabouts, to the pawstep
features.description: Live GPS with geo-fenced safe zones and a breadcrumb trail of every wander, so a bolted back gate becomes a notification, not a night of searching.

features.title: Vitals that see ahead
features.description: Resting heart rate, temperature, and activity curves are modeled nightly. When a trend drifts from your pet's normal, we flag it before the limp appears.

features.title: Behavior, decoded
features.description: Our model reads sleep fragmentation, scratching, and pacing to translate restlessness into plain language you can bring to the vet.

features.title: One record, every clinic
features.description: Vaccines, meds, allergies, and past visits live in a single shareable dossier — no more digging through email for the rabies certificate.

features.title: Alerts before it hurts
features.description: Set thresholds once and let Compass watch around the clock, nudging you the moment something meaningful changes.

features.title: A map for the whole pack
features.description: Track dogs, cats, and the occasional house rabbit side by side, with a shared timeline the whole family can see.

testimonials.quote: Compass flagged my greyhound's resting heart rate climbing for four straight nights. The vet caught early cardiomyopathy. I would never have noticed on my own.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: I foster six cats at a time. The shared dossier and per-pet alerts mean I finally hand off a full medical timeline to adopters instead of a shoebox of receipts.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ellery

testimonials.quote: The behavior translations are uncanny. Compass told me my terrier's pacing spiked every evening — turned out to be separation anxiety we're now treating.
testimonials.name: Dr. Lena Vossberg

pricing.blurb: Live location and the essentials for one curious companion.
Predictive health and behavior intelligence for the devoted.
The full pack on one map, for multi-pet homes and fosters.

homepage.footerBlurb: Otter Compass is the intelligence layer for every life you love with a heartbeat and a tail. See the whole animal, sooner.
